newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway new T-bill auction highest yield 3.91 pct.
newsitem.headline: Norway new T-bill auction highest yield 3.91 pct.

text.p: Norway's central bank, Norges Bank, said on Monday that an auction of a new 12-month treasury bill known as SS47 produced a highest yield of 3.91 percent.
The lowest yield at the ordinary auction was 3.83 percent and the weighted average was 3.35 percent. Bids for the highest accepted rate had a 76 percent allotment.

The bank announced the T-bill last Thursday at 3.5 billion crowns, with 500 million crowns reserved for the central bank. The T-bill has a nominal interest rate of 3.70 percent and matures on March 18, 1998.
